```{r}
library(dplyr)
```

1. Light data (photometer)
a. import and tidy
```{r}
light<-read.csv("light_data.csv", header=T, na.strings = c("", "NA"))

light_data<-light %>%
  mutate(treatment = fct_recode(treatment,
    "Invaded" = "Acacia",
    "Uninvaded" = "Grassland"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("Uninvaded", "Invaded"))) %>% 
  group_by(treatment) %>% 
  summarise(mean_light = mean(light),
            se_light =sd(light)/sqrt(n()))
```

b. plot (Figure S2b)
```{r}
ggplot(data = light_data %>% filter(treatment!="Cleared")) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = treatment, y = mean_light, shape = treatment),size= 4)+
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(x = treatment, ymin = mean_light - se_light, ymax = mean_light + se_light, group = treatment), 
    width = 0.05) +
  labs(
    x = "Environment",
    y = "Mean (±SE) light availability (Lumen)",
    shape = "Treatment"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Invaded" = 5, "Uninvaded" = 3))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 10)) + 
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
theme(
  strip.background = element_blank(),
  strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),

  legend.position = "right",
  legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
  legend.text = element_text(),

  axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
  axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),

  axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.6),
  axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),

  panel.grid = element_blank(),

  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
  plot.margin = margin(6, 8, 6, 6)
)

ggsave("figureS2b.tiff",
       width = 3.5, height = 4,
       units = "in", dpi = 300,
       compression = "lzw")
```

c. Test statistical significance
```{r}
stat_light<-lmer( light ~ treatment +(1|plot)+(1|time), data=light %>% filter(treatment!="Cleared"))
display(stat_light)
summary(stat_light)
anova(stat_light)
emmeans(stat_light, list(pairwise~treatment), adjust="tukey")
```

2. Temperature data from ibuttons
a. Import and tidy
```{r}
october_ibuttons <- list.files(path = '/Users/devbagdi/Research/Decomposition in Nilgiri/manuscript/ibutton_data/october_24', pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)

july_ibuttons<- list.files(path = '/Users/devbagdi/Research/Decomposition in Nilgiri/manuscript/ibutton_data/JULY_25', pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)


#function for processing ibutton files with the plot name in file name
process_file <- function(file_name) {
  
  # Read the CSV file
  data <- read.csv(file_name, skip = 14)
  
  # Extract treatment and plot info
  treatment <- case_when(
    startsWith(basename(file_name), "i") ~ "acacia",
    startsWith(basename(file_name), "u") ~ "grassland",
    TRUE ~ "unknown"
  )
  plot_code <- substr(basename(file_name), 1, 2)
  plot <- substr(plot_code, 2, 2)
  
  # Separate date-time, convert time, and classify day/night
  data <- data %>%
    separate(col = `Date.Time`, into = c("date", "time", "AMPM"), sep = " ") %>%
    mutate(
      Time_24hr = format(strptime(paste(time, AMPM), "%I:%M:%S %p"), "%H:%M:%S"),
      Date_time = as.POSIXct(paste(date, Time_24hr), format = "%d/%m/%y %H:%M:%S"),
      segment = case_when(
      hour(Date_time) >= 0  & hour(Date_time) < 7  ~ "night",
      hour(Date_time) >=7 & hour(Date_time) < 17 ~ "day",
      hour(Date_time) >= 17 & hour(Date_time) <= 23 ~ "night")
      
    )
  
  # Add constant metadata columns
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      treatment = treatment,
      plot_code = plot_code,
      plot = plot
    )
  
  return(data)
}


# Apply the process_file function to all CSV files
october_processed_data <- lapply(october_ibuttons, process_file)
july_processed_data <- lapply(july_ibuttons, process_file)


# Combine all the processed data into one dataframe
october_combined_data <- bind_rows(october_processed_data)
july_combined_data<-bind_rows(july_processed_data)
temp_data<-bind_rows(october_combined_data, july_combined_data)
```

b. More tidy (dataframes)
```{r}

#Table S1
```

```{r}
  group_by(treatment, plot_code) |> 
  summarise(t=mean(Value))

head(temp_data_plot)
```

c. Tidy and stats for daily difference in temperature
```{r}
#maxmin diff for each day in each site
mean_temp_diff <- temp_data %>%
  group_by(plot_code,date,treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    difference = max(Value)-min(Value)
  )


stat_temp_diff<-lmer( difference ~ treatment+(1|plot_code)+(1|date), data=mean_temp_diff %>% filter(treatment!="cleared"))
display(stat_temp_diff)
anova(stat_temp_diff)
emmeans(stat_temp_diff, list(pairwise~treatment), adjust="tukey")
```

d. Dataframe for day-segments
```{r}
#mean temp for each segment in each day in each site
mean_temp_segment <-temp_data %>%
  group_by(treatment,segment) %>% 
summarise(temp_mean=mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
          temp_se = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(n()))

```

Stats for each segment
- for day
```{r}
stat_temp_day<-lmer( Value ~ treatment+(1|plot_code)+(1|date), data=temp_data %>% filter(segment=="day"&treatment!="cleared"))
display(stat_temp_day)
anova(stat_temp_day)
emmeans(stat_temp_day, ~treatment)
emm_temp_day=emmeans(stat_temp_day, ~treatment)
pairs(emm_temp_day, simple='each')
```

-for night
```{r}
stat_temp_night<-lmer( Value ~ treatment+(1|plot_code) +(1|date), data=temp_data %>% filter(segment=="night"&treatment!="cleared"))
display(stat_temp_night)
anova(stat_temp_night)
emmeans(stat_temp_night, ~treatment)
emm_temp_night = emmeans(stat_temp_night, ~treatment)
pairs(emm_temp_night, simple='each')
```

e. Tidy for plotting hourly mean

```{r}
temp_data <- temp_data %>%
  mutate(
    DateTime_full = as.POSIXct(paste(date, Time_24hr), format = "%d/%m/%y %H:%M:%S")
  )

temp <- temp_data %>%
  group_by(treatment, date, hour = floor_date(DateTime_full, "hour")) %>%
  summarise(avg_temperature = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_temperature= sd(Value))

#Splitting date and time column

temp <- temp %>%
  mutate(date = as_date(hour),
         time = format(hour, "%H:%M:%S"))

#taking hourly average for each days

temp_ <- temp %>%
  group_by( time, treatment) %>%
  summarise(temperature = mean(avg_temperature),
            temp_se=sd(avg_temperature)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup()

```

plotting
```{r}
ggplot(
  data = temp_,
  mapping = aes(x = time, y = temperature, shape = treatment))+
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(
labels = c(
      "acacia" = "Invaded",
      "grassland" = "Uninvaded"
    )) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("acacia" = 5, "grassland" = 3),
labels = c(
      "acacia" = "Invaded",
      "grassland" = "Uninvaded"
    )) + # Custom shapes
  labs(x = "Time of the day", y = "Mean temperature (\u00b0C)", color="Habitat", shape="Habitat") +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = c("00:00:00", "06:00:00", "12:00:00", "18:00:00")) +

  legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),

)+

theme(

)
```
